toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target is image1. Image2 is exact Cache identity reference.
Change ONLY Cache Back's BODY STRIDE DIRECTION in image1 so he is unmistakably walking TOWARD the visible driver's door of the yellow car at screen-right. At present he reads as walking toward the viewer; fix this.
Preserve the entire exact garage, skyline, wet night street, yellow hatchback, its parked orientation, roof recorder, rear glass two tape reels, stripes/emblems, tires, light/color and detailed comic style. Do NOT redraw the car or change any object arrangement.
Rotate Cache's shoulders/hips/legs into a right-facing three-quarter walking profile. His near shoulder and back edge face the viewer a little; knees, hips and leading toe point DIAGONALLY RIGHT toward the left-side driver door at the car's screen-left side. One foot is naturally stepping toward that door, other behind. Keep his head turned slightly back toward camera so both clear glasses and black tech mask remain recognizable; relaxed confident badass glance, not surprise.
Keep his small metal key ring in his RIGHT hand closest to the driver door, keys visible, natural finger/thumb holding ring. Keep the exact protected black archive cassette with yellow hazard band secured under his LEFT arm against his hip. Do not swap/destroy cassette or duplicate props. Preserve yellow cap's two rounded protrusions, yellow Greek-key short sleeves, clear glasses, mechanical collar and dark trousers. Slim natural human anatomy, correct connected arms/hands, no giant action-hero muscles.
Maintain existing foreground scale, place him on the same pavement with natural foot contact, allow knees/shoes to remain inside bottom image if possible. No walking toward viewer and no walking away from car. Leave car door shut until the next implied action. No new text, captions, effects, HUD, characters or weapons. Opaque background.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: corrected detailed comic game cutscene, wide landscape panel matching image 1 (1860x845 composition).
Primary request: EDIT IMAGE 1. Correct ONLY Cache Back's walking torso and arm pose. The current case-holding arm is behind his back; that is rejected. Give him an anatomically natural confident walk toward the same yellow car at screen-right, with BOTH forearms and BOTH hands fully and clearly visible in FRONT of his torso. This is a targeted pose correction, not a redesigned scene.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual edit target and locks the street, garage, car, viewpoint, lighting and illustration style. Image 2 locks the SAME yellow hatchback's rear geometry, roof recorder and two rear-window reels, vehicle stripes/emblem, tow hook and exhaust. Image 3 locks Cache's exact face, cap, glasses, tech mask/collar and yellow-shirt identity; DO NOT copy its twisted rear-facing pose.
Corrected pose: show the FRONT of Cache's chest in an easy three-quarter orientation toward screen-right and the driver's door. His shoulders, ribs and hips turn together toward his walking direction without an extreme spinal twist. His head makes only a small confident glance toward the viewer. Reposition him within the same left foreground if necessary so his approach to the car remains credible. Natural walking stride and grounded yellow shoes; he is not walking toward the viewer or away from the car.
Arms and carried items, critical: exactly two connected human arms. Each shoulder-to-upper-arm-to-elbow-to-forearm-to-wrist path must be visible and anatomically plausible. His forward hand (toward the car) holds a small metal key ring at WAIST LEVEL, with clearly visible keys dangling below the fingers. The opposite hand and forearm support the protected chunky black original-recording case with its yellow hazard band IN FRONT OF HIS LOWER CHEST/ABDOMEN. That hand cups the case's bottom/front; its naturally bent elbow and forearm remain visible alongside and in front of his torso. The case is never behind him or under a hidden backward arm. Both wrists and both hands visible. Keep elbows relaxed rather than forced backward; shoulders level and natural. Hands, fingers, keys and case must be distinct at normal panel size.
Identity/style invariants: same Cache, yellow cap with side flaps, dark glasses, black tech mask and mechanical collar, yellow short-sleeve shirt with black Greek-key trim, black pants and yellow/black sneakers. No other characters. Same detailed painted comic-ink realism, crisp edges and wet amber/cyan/plum night city. Preserve the existing SAME yellow hatchback parked on screen-right, unchanged left driver-door side and rear three-quarter angle, rooftop recorder straps, twin reels, hatch design, stripes, emblem, wheels, left exhaust and tow hook. Keep the garage opening at left, road/city props and wet reflections.
Avoid: NO arm or hand behind back, hip or torso; NO hidden forearm, shoulder dislocation, twisted torso, extra limb, fused fingers, floating key ring, bent impossible wrist, sleeve covering the hand, changed face/clothes, changed vehicle, mirrored car, new props, text/captions or watermarks. Preserve existing background and vehicle as closely as possible. The only intended change is a clearly readable natural forward-carry walking pose.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised detailed comic game cutscene, wide landscape 1860x845 composition.
Primary request: In IMAGE 1, REPLACE THE ENTIRE CACHE CHARACTER from cap to both shoes with a NEW, SINGLE anatomically coherent rightward walking pose. Keep the background and yellow car unchanged. The old legs/feet and the last torso edit were rejected for pointing in different directions. DO NOT preserve any of the old character pose, limbs or shoes' angles. This must be a full character-pose replacement, not an upper-body patch.
Input images: Image 1 is BACKGROUND/VEHICLE/STYLE only, not a pose reference. It locks the same wet avenue, left garage, night skyline, yellow car position/camera, roof recorder, two rear-window reels, stripes/emblem/tow hook/exhaust. Image 2 supplies Cache's facial identity, yellow cap, dark glasses, black tech mask/collar and yellow shirt trim only; do not copy its torso twist or camera glance.
NEW coherent pose: Cache occupies the left foreground and walks unmistakably toward screen RIGHT, toward the visible driver door of the same car. Near SIDE PROFILE of the WHOLE body, with only slight front-quarter visibility (about 10-15 degrees) for the carried case. His cap brim, nose/mask, gaze, chest/shoulders, pelvis/hips, BOTH knees and BOTH shoe toes all point along the SAME direction to the RIGHT. Chin confidently up, eyes looking FORWARD to the car, no look-back or face turned toward the camera. Shoulder girdle and pelvis aligned along the same forward axis; no twisting between ribs and hips. Natural relaxed male walking gait, connected joints, clean full-body silhouette.
Legs/feet are critical: construct BOTH LEGS anew. Leading leg steps gently toward screen-right, leading knee and shoe toe point RIGHT, leading heel makes grounded contact on the wet pavement. Rear leg trails to screen-left, with heel raised naturally while its forefoot remains on pavement and its toes also point RIGHT. Two realistic sneakers, same scale and correct left/right anatomy, neither foot points left, toward the viewer, or across the other leg. Both knees bend along the rightward walking direction; no crossed or reversed knees/ankles, no pigeon toes, no outward splayed soles. The whole figure could take its next step to the RIGHT naturally without rotating or untwisting.
Both hands and forearms must remain readable on the front/rightward side of the silhouette: one forward hand at waist level carries a small metal key ring with visible keys dangling. The other arm bends naturally across the FRONT of his abdomen to support the protected black original-recording case with yellow hazard band. Both shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist paths plausible; forearms/hands visible, not hidden behind back, hip or torso. Case stays in front of the abdomen, never behind his back. No forceful backward elbows. Keep the arms compact enough that they do not obscure the hips or direction of the gait.
Identity/style invariants: same Cache in yellow cap with side flaps, dark glasses, black mechanical mask/collar, yellow short-sleeve Greek-key-trim shirt, black pants, yellow/black sneakers, protected original case. Detailed sharp painted comic ink matching IMAGE 1. Same car/garage/avenue props and wet amber/cyan/plum night lighting. No extra people, no scene redesign.
Avoid: preserving old legs, hybrid front torso/rear legs, a front-facing chest, backward head glance, opposite-pointing feet, extreme perspective foreshortening, torso twist, extra limbs, floating/disconnected hands, impossible wrists, hidden case-holding forearm, changed vehicle geometry, mirrored car, added props, captions/text or watermarks.
